Sandbox_ZedManager_ViewLock_tooltip: When on, players are held in Viewpoint first person from the moment they join. The O key (isometric switch) is blocked and Shift+O switches first <-> third person only. Players who cannot get first/third person (no ZombieBuddy or Viewpoint) are shown a notice and sent back to the main menu (admins excepted).
Sandbox_ZedManager_AdminIsometric: Admins may use the isometric view
Sandbox_ZedManager_AdminIsometric_toolti: When checked, admins are not held and can switch to the isometric view with the O key. Uncheck to hold admins in first/third person too.
